xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4279: Dashboard outage handling blocks the whole UI (and there are several outage screens): replace with one non-blocking degraded-mode banner

plan.title: Dashboard outage handling blocks the whole UI (and there are several outage screens): replace with one non-blocking degraded-mode banner
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: About 30 files, all under src/dashboard/frontend plus one doc and the root package.json (3 subsystems). The issue's acceptance criteria bind the banner, the removal of every blocking outage surface, disabled write actions, offline composer hold and one browser suite together; splitting would ship a banner that promises behavior a sibling issue delivers. Nine of the files are one-line guard deletions (remove-outage-guards).

narratives.Problem: When the dashboard tab loses touch with its server, even falsely, the UI blocks: BackendConnectionBoundary hides every route with display:none, EventRouter shows a modal 'Server unreachable — Retry' overlay (after a 3-minute bootstrap window or 6 stream retries), and AppChrome renders three more restart/down/back-up banners. On 2026-09-27 ~23:30 UTC the overlay covered a conversation while the server was healthy. The code proves why it can happen: bootstrap has no timeout, a hung getSnapshot/session fetch pins bootstrapInFlight, which makes the overlay's Retry a no-op, and the poller gives up after 3 minutes.
narratives.Proposal: Introduce one connection store (lib/connectionState.ts) that derives live/delayed/unreachable/restarting from the health poll, on-demand /api/health probes (JSON status at any HTTP status = reachable), EventRouter stream state and the restart lifecycle. Render one DegradedModeBanner ('Can't reach the Overdeck server — showing data from HH:MM · Retry', 'Live updates are delayed — reconnecting', restarting) and keep the last-known UI mounted and navigable; a full-page screen appears only on a first load with no snapshot. Bound bootstrap with a 20 s timeout, retry with backoff forever, make Retry always start a fresh attempt, delete both EventRouter overlays and the now-dead backendOutageState guards, disable server-backed issue actions with a visible reason, hold composer prompts typed while unreachable and send them on reconnect, restrict the asset-recovery overlay to React-down crashes, and prove it with an isolated-dashboard Playwright suite plus docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No server-side changes (health route, RPC, snapshot).
- No persistence of held composer messages across a full page reload.
- No offline queueing of issue actions or any non-composer mutation; they are disabled, not queued.
- No change to XTerminal.tsx, RootErrorBoundary, or the reload circuit-breaker overlay.
- No change to region-level boundaries (LoadingBoundary, ProjectMembershipBoundary, Flywheel unreachable chip).
- No gating of mutations outside the issue-action registry and the composer; they keep failing with their existing toasts.
- No replay of the live 23:30 incident; the root cause is fixed from code-provable failure modes.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the 5 s /api/version poll as the reachability source and add on-demand /api/health probes from EventRouter.
autoDecisions.rationale: The /api/version poll also caches supervisorUrl for Force Restart; the issue asks for an /api/health probe before claiming unreachable. Both feed one store.

autoDecisions.summary: A response with a JSON body carrying a string status field counts as reachable at any HTTP status; non-JSON 5xx, network errors and 3 s timeouts are unreachable.
autoDecisions.rationale: /api/health returns 503 JSON in incoherent states while the server is up; Traefik returns HTML 502/503/504 when the backend is down.

autoDecisions.summary: Bootstrap timeout 20 s, then endless backoff (existing 2 s doubling, 30 s cap); Retry abandons any in-flight attempt via a generation counter.
autoDecisions.rationale: Server logs show getSnapshot resolving in ~5 ms, so 20 s only trips on a hung request; endless backoff replaces the 3-minute give-up that caused the false alarm.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete lib/backendOutageState.ts and all seven isBackendOutage() guards.
autoDecisions.rationale: They exist only because the page was hidden; with no hiding they are permanently false, and two of them would block navigation shortcuts and held sends.

autoDecisions.summary: Offline-blocked issue actions stay visible (disabled with a tooltip) instead of vanishing from overflow.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires actions disabled with an explanation; layout.rest otherwise filters out disabled entries.

autoDecisions.summary: Hold composer prompts before POSTing when unreachable/restarting; /pan commands are refused with a toast and the draft kept.
autoDecisions.rationale: Holding before the POST makes the reconnect send a first attempt, which is safe for both the conversation and agent endpoints; commands need a live structured response.

autoDecisions.summary: Fold AppChrome's restart, unreachable (keeping Force Restart) and back-up banners into the one DegradedModeBanner.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for exactly one outage indicator; Force Restart is still useful when the server is wedged.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the asset-recovery overlay only for the root_error_boundary trigger; keep RootErrorBoundary and the reload circuit breaker.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those are crash states where React may be down; chunk-load failures with React alive now poll silently behind the banner.

autoDecisions.summary: One plan with sizeJustification instead of sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance criteria tie banner, offline send, disabled actions and the browser suite together; the file count is inflated by nine one-line guard deletions.

items.title: Add the connection store that derives the live/delayed/unreachable/restarting phase

verify_commands: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/connectionState.test.ts

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-1 exactly: create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/connectionState.ts (Zustand, same style as lib/backendOutageState.ts) exporting ConnectionPhase, useConnectionState (inputs serverReachable=true, streamLive=false, restarting=false, hasSnapshot=false, lastLiveAt=null; setters setServerReachable, setStreamLive(v, at?), setRestarting, markSnapshotCached(timestamp), registerReconnect(fn|null), requestReconnect()), deriveConnectionPhase (precedence restarting > unreachable > delayed > live, PRD D2), useConnectionPhase, isWriteBlockedPhase (unreachable|restarting), isServerWriteBlocked, showFirstLoadScreen (no snapshot AND unreachable|restarting), OFFLINE_ACTION_REASON = "Can't reach the Overdeck server — available again when it reconnects.", and probeServerHealth(fetchImpl=fetch) which GETs /api/health with AbortSignal.timeout(3000) and returns true iff the body parses as JSON with a string `status` field at any HTTP status (PRD glossary 'Reachable'). Tests use vi.useFakeTimers for the timeout case.

items.title: Given serverReachable=false and restarting=true, deriveConnectionPhase returns 'restarting'; given serverReachable=true and streamLive=false it returns 'delayed'; given serverReachable=false and restarting=false it returns 'unreachable'.
probeServerHealth returns true for a 503 response with JSON body {status:'incoherent'} and false for a 502 response with an HTML body.
Given a fetch that never settles, probeServerHealth resolves false after 3000 ms of fake time.
showFirstLoadScreen returns false whenever hasSnapshot is true and returns true for hasSnapshot=false with phase 'unreachable'.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-2. FIRST write the reproduction test (getSnapshot mock never settles; on unmodified code the overlay appears after 3 min and Retry issues no new getSnapshot) and record in the PR whether it reproduced. Then: add loadSnapshotCacheEntry() returning {data,timestamp} to snapshotCache.ts (keep loadSnapshotFromCache as a wrapper); on mount call markSnapshotCached(Date.parse(timestamp)); race getSnapshot against a 20_000 ms timeout (BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT_MS) and add a generation counter so a superseded attempt never calls syncSnapshot; on success setStreamLive(true); on failure/timeout setStreamLive(false), probeServerHealth().then(setServerReachable), schedule reconnect with eventRouterReconnectDelayMs; markBackendReconnecting also sets streamLive=false and probes health; delete SNAPSHOT_FALLBACK_WINDOW_MS, UNREACHABLE_OVERLAY_RETRY_ATTEMPTS, the fallbackTimeout branch, every showOverlay/hideOverlay call and the '../recovery' import; registerReconnect(forceReconnect) on mount (forceReconnect bumps generation, clears bootstrapInFlight/bootstrapPromise, resets reconnectAttempt, runs reconnectDomainStream({fullReset:true})) and registerReconnect(null) on cleanup. Keep dispatchBackendReconnecting/Reconnected. Rewrite the three existing overlay-asserting tests (lines ~320, ~492, ~617) to assert #pan-recovery-overlay is never created. All tests use fake timers.

items.title: Given getSnapshot never settles, after 20 s of fake time a second getSnapshot request is issued after backoff and document.getElementById('pan-recovery-overlay') returns null at every step including after 3 minutes.
Given a bootstrap is in flight, calling useConnectionState.getState().requestReconnect() issues a new getSnapshot immediately, and the stale attempt resolving later does not call syncSnapshot.
Given the domain stream fails while /api/health answers JSON, the connection phase becomes 'delayed', not 'unreachable'.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-3. New components/DegradedModeBanner.tsx reads useConnectionPhase and lastLiveAt; exact copy: unreachable "Can't reach the Overdeck server — showing data from HH:MM" + Retry + Force Restart (onRestartBackend, 'Restarting…' while pending); restarting "Overdeck server is restarting — showing data from HH:MM" + lifecycle issueId/reason suffix as AppChrome.tsx:114-119 renders today; delayed "Live updates are delayed — reconnecting · showing data from HH:MM" + Retry; transition to live shows "Reconnected" for 2.5 s; live renders nothing. HH:MM = new Date(lastLiveAt).toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}); omit the ' — showing data from' clause when lastLiveAt is null. Attributes role=status aria-live=polite data-component=degraded-mode-banner data-phase={phase}; theme tokens only, pan-style-guide (no pills). Retry calls useConnectionState.getState().requestReconnect() and refetches the ['backend-health'] query. In AppChrome.tsx delete the restart/down/recovering banner blocks (lines ~108-151) and their props, render DegradedModeBanner there. In App.tsx delete bannerState/recoveryTimerRef state machine (~lines 291-320) and add an effect: setServerReachable(!(backendDown && backendFailureCount >= 2)); setRestarting(dashboardLifecycle.active). App.tsx must not grow (it is over the 1000-line ceiling).

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-8. Extend startIsolatedDashboard(opts?: {port?, home?}) and stop(opts?: {keepHome?}) without changing defaults for project-create-ux.spec.ts. Each test uses a fresh browser.newContext() (isolated profile; never the live 3011 dashboard or another agent's browser). Scenarios: (1) server stopped with warm cache -> banner data-phase=unreachable, navigation /pipeline -> /board -> /pipeline renders cached content, issue-action write items disabled with the offline reason, no display:none wrapper around the route view; (2) page.routeWebSocket(/\/ws\/rpc/, ws => ws.close()) with /api/health answering -> banner data-phase=delayed contains 'Live updates are delayed' and 'Server unreachable' appears nowhere; (3) empty localStorage + server stopped -> [data-component=first-load-screen] and no route content; restart on same port/home -> app loads; (4) held message sent once after restart (implementation checkpoint: if the fixture cannot host a conversation, page.route-intercept POST /api/conversations/*/message after restart and assert one POST with the held clientMessageId); (5) screenshots of unreachable and delayed banners in light and dark (toggle the 'light' class on <html> as tests/theme-screenshots.spec.ts does) to test-results/pan-4279/<phase>-<theme>.png. Terminal inline state: assert if the fixture exposes a terminal, otherwise note in the PR that XTerminal.tsx is unchanged. Attach screenshots and the PRD audit table to the PR body.
